brief.headline: Push for 8–12% price cut: they keep 8.5% profit vs. 4.8% for similar firms — room to share that margin.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for 8–12% off current prices on rigid plastic packaging
priceAsk.target: Target ₹0.65–0.80/pc on caps (market research shows modest headroom at higher volume)
priceAsk.basis: They keep 8.5% of every ₹100 they sell; similar firms keep only 4.8%. That 3.7 percentage-point gap is room they can share with us. Market research on 28 mm PP caps shows asking prices ₹0.55–1.20/pc with typical ₹0.85–0.95/pc, and headroom to ₹0.65–0.80 at higher volume — so push toward the lower end.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move from 45 days to 30 days after receipt

brief.financialLeverage: They're healthy — score 70/100, safe zone, zero debt, and they keep a comfortable 8.5% profit. But their cash is stuck for 124 days (peers: 114 days), so they're a bit cash-tight. We're tiny to them — just 0.15% of their ₹179.69 Cr revenue. That means we can't squeeze hard on our own, but we can ask for a fair share of their extra margin and tie it to faster payment or a multi-year commit. Play the alternates to show we have options.

risks: We're only 0.15% of their business (₹26.17 L spend vs. ₹179.69 Cr revenue) — on our own we have little pull; bundle more volume or play off an alternate to get traction.

brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to talk about closing the gap between your 8.5% profit and the 4.8% your peers keep — and in return we can look at faster payment and a longer commit.
